suites.name: Frontend Smoke Test
suites.task: Navigate to the homepage. Ensure the application loads without a blank screen. Verify that the main map or dashboard components are rendered.

suites.name: Demo Pipeline End-to-End
suites.task: Navigate to the /analysis page. Select the 'DEMO pipeline' option. Click 'Analyze DEMO pipeline' and wait for the results. Verify that an incident report is generated and the UI shows 'SPILL_DETECTED' or 'NO_SPILL_DETECTED' or 'ANALYSIS_INCONCLUSIVE' and does not throw an unhandled exception.

suites.name: Settings / Configuration Form Validation
suites.task: If there are forms or configuration panels in the UI, try to submit empty or invalid data. Verify that appropriate error messages are displayed and the application does not crash.

suites.name: API Resilience Test
suites.task: Perform a standard workflow (e.g. Analysis) and simulate network slowness or backend 500 error if possible via TinyFish network interception. Ensure the UI displays a clear, understandable error message.
